claim: Funding-conditioned features improve out-of-sample forecasting of observed Hyperliquid perpetual liquidation intensity (notional_usd-weighted liquidation event count per symbol per 24h) vs RV-only baseline, on a new Hyperliquid panel (2025-06..2026-10), pre-registered before any outcome computation.

panel.symbols: All *-PERP markets with >=1 liquidation event in each complete month; minimum 5 symbols/month required (observed 164-353 distinct markets/month)
panel.label: observed_hyperliquid_liquidation_event_rows
panel.label_definition: Raw ironflow events rows (observed liquidations, not modeled/proxy/synthetic). label = notional_usd-weighted liquidation event count per symbol per 24h UTC bucket.

split_boundaries.rule: Chronological splits by unique UTC timestamps across the common symbol panel; 7-day embargo between partitions

primary_target: next-24h observed liquidation intensity (notional_usd-weighted event count per symbol)
metric: QLIKE (lower is better) on observed liquidation intensity
forbidden: No sealed-holdout reuse (FCLR-002/FCLR-003/Track B/C test sets are sealed)
No modeled/proxy/synthetic liquidation labels (observed ironflow events only)
No outcome inspection before preregistration freeze
No risk overlay before forecast gate is met
No network polling or redundant GETs beyond cached provenance
next_step: Build aligned analysis panel (liquidation events + Hyperliquid market/funding/price context from admissible unauthenticated sources, with provenance) or document blocker if alignment data inadmissible. Then run pre-registered evaluation.
